about.heading: Clay, fire, and quiet hands
paragraphs: Orbit Ceramic began in a loft workshop where stone and ash glaze meet. Each piece is thrown by hand, dried slowly, and fired until the surface holds a lived-in calm — brutal in material, soft in use.
We keep the story short so the work can speak: honest forms for coffee, bread, flowers, and the table you return to every day.
